_comment: All timings are in SECONDS. Keep these human. Going too fast is the #1 reason WhatsApp bans accounts.

auth._help: Password to open the web dashboard. CHANGE THIS before putting it online. Leave empty ("") to disable. You can also set it via the WATITOOL_PASSWORD environment variable, which overrides this and keeps it out of the file.

vars._help: Optional. Controls how {{date}}, {{time}}, {{day}} are formatted. e.g. locale "ar-EG" + timezone "Africa/Cairo" for Arabic dates in Cairo time. Leave empty to use the server's defaults.

bot._help: Master switch for auto-replies AND flows. Only works while connected. cooldownSeconds throttles repeated replies to the same person (ignored mid-flow). exitKeywords end an active flow.

schedule._help: Sending window in the timezone set under vars.timezone (Settings → Date & time). When enabled, a running campaign only sends between start and end, and pauses outside those hours. Supports overnight windows (e.g. start 22:00, end 06:00).

_countryCode_help: Default country code added to numbers that don't already include one. 20 = Egypt, 966 = KSA, 971 = UAE, 1 = US/CA.

delay._help: A RANDOM wait is picked between min and max after every message. Real people are not robots — never make this a fixed value.

typing._help: Shows the 'typing…' indicator for a duration based on message length, so the contact sees a natural pause before the text lands.

batch._help: After every <size> messages, take a longer break of <restMinutes>. Mimics a human taking a break and spreads load across the day.

safety._checkRegistered_help: Skip numbers that are not on WhatsApp (avoids wasting sends and looking like a spam blast).
safety._maxPerRun_help: Hard cap on messages per run (0 = no cap). Useful while warming up a new number.
safety._skipAlreadySent_help: Reads results.csv and never messages the same number twice. Makes the run fully resumable.
safety._autoResume_help: Crash-safe: if a campaign is interrupted (crash/restart/disconnect), resume it automatically once reconnected (already-sent are skipped).

banGuard._help: Ban guardrail: if fewer than minDeliveredPct of the last sampleSize messages get a delivered receipt within graceSeconds, auto-pause the campaign (your number may be throttled/blocked).

frequencyCap._help: Never message the same contact more than once within this many days (across all campaigns).

warmup._help: New-number warmup: cap total real messages per day, ramping up startPerDay + step×(days since first send), up to maxPerDay.

trickle._help: Trickle mode: ignore the fixed delay and instead spread the whole list evenly across this many hours (looks more human, lowers ban risk).

approval._help: When on, a real send must be approved first (Submit for approval → Approve & send). Prevents accidental big sends and supports a reviewer.

optOut.reply: You've been unsubscribed ✅. Reply START to opt back in.
optOut._help: When someone replies with an opt-out keyword they're added to the blocklist and excluded from all campaigns (honored even if the bot is off).

alerts._help: If enabled, watitool sends a WhatsApp alert to this number when it reconnects after a disconnect or auto-pauses a campaign. Use international format, e.g. 2010xxxxxxxx.

_publicUrl_help: Your deployed dashboard URL (e.g. https://whatsapptoolh-production.up.railway.app). Required for click-tracked short links — {{track:CODE}} in a message becomes <publicUrl>/l/CODE?c=<number>.
_onlinePresence_help: Keep the account marked online while the campaign runs.
